summary: Verified the module-ownership + navigation-cleanliness pass. moduleRegistry unit checks (25/25) pass. minor.issue: Flaky under full-suite parallel execution; each passes when run alone. Likely fixture/data cross-contamination between v2_1 and v2_2 test files running in parallel workers. Pre-existing (no backend changes in this pass).

issues: The StudioSidebar in /app/frontend/src/pages/StudioSession.jsx (line 196) still hard-codes a 'Vaulta' link and (line 197) 'Integrations'/'Settings' etc. This is inconsistent with the new Module Registry / EcosystemMenu architecture — Vaulta is a sibling ecosystem module and should be surfaced through the EcosystemMenu only, not via a page-local sidebar that presents it as an INHEIRA surface. Recommend refactoring StudioSidebar to read from moduleRegistry (moduleHref) or to drop the Vaulta row entirely so the primary discovery of sibling modules stays canonical.

action_items: Investigate parallel-test isolation for test_auto_doc_v2_1.py (fixtures likely share a session_id / DB row with test_voice_evidence_v2_2.py; tests pass when run alone). Consider unique per-test session_ids or serialize the v2_1 file.
Optionally remove/relabel the 'Vaulta' row from StudioSidebar (StudioSession.jsx line 196) to keep the Ecosystem-menu-as-single-source-of-truth invariant.

Backend flakiness on test_auto_doc_v2_1 is pre-existing test-isolation noise unrelated to this pass.
rca_of_the_issue: Backend flake: three tests in test_auto_doc_v2_1.py fail only when the full suite is run in parallel (pytest-xdist workers), and pass 100% when the file is run alone. Root cause is almost certainly shared state (e.g., a fixed sess_/ver_/ack_ ID) between test_auto_doc_v2_1 and test_voice_evidence_v2_2 running on different workers hitting the same MongoDB. Fix: parametrize per-test session/version/ack IDs with a uuid4() suffix, or add a session-scoped cleanup that guards on prefix; alternatively serialize these two files with a filelock or pytest-order marker.
